steps.title: Break ground
steps.instruction: Place a Drill on the ground beside the Core.

steps.title: Lay pipe
steps.instruction: Research Power Grid. Ore only moves along conduits.

steps.title: Connect the drill
steps.instruction: Run conduits from the Core to the Drill so drones can reach it.

steps.title: Think faster
steps.instruction: Build a Server Bank. Data is what research is made of.

steps.title: Stop borrowing power
steps.instruction: Build a Wind Turbine. Mountains give it more to work with.
